reference.why: Allan picked Style 4 on his design form (no demo URL pasted), which resolves to demo-nutritionist: half-and-half reversed hero, split bands, card overview, CTA banner. Deliberate deviations, decided before building: palette is his own (logo yellow plus the plum, amber and leaf green of the two mood photos he uploaded) instead of calm-sage, because he said he likes yellow and asked us to use those photos as the palette; he has no testimonials, so the demo's testimonial bands become his own content (his counselling room on home, his creative tools on services); an announcement strip carries his 'currently fully booked' note on every page; no FAQ page because he has no FAQ content. After the first blind critic (01-11-2026): the hero text column is widened (hero--half--text-wide) so the three tick pills sit on one row; the CTA bands use his logo yellow (band band--2) and the home room gallery sits on his leaf green (band band--3), so the site carries his yellow brand and a second calm tint rather than one plum family.
